prompt_short: Need an opener for a meeting

assertions.text: Response contains at least one question mark
assertions.evidence: Multiple question marks: 'Who's in the room?', 'What tone fits the room?', 'What industry or company is this?'

assertions.text: Response does NOT contain all five strategy labels (Relationship, Purpose, Curiosity, Proof, Time)
assertions.evidence: None of the five strategy labels appear — response is entirely clarifying questions.

assertions.text: Response asks about audience, tone, or industry
assertions.evidence: Explicitly asks all three: audience ('Who's in the room?'), tone ('What tone fits the room?'), industry ('What industry or company is this?').
